# Navigation Menu

> A site's navigation: links, plus buttons that show and hide links of their own. It's the APG's disclosure navigation, not a menu.

`<slab-navigation-menu>` · Navigation · built on `<nav> + <button aria-expanded>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/navigation-menu/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/navigation-menu.js';
import 'slab-elements/navigation-menu.item.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-navigation-menu label="Main">
  <a href="/" aria-current="page">Home</a>

  <slab-navigation-menu-item label="Products">
    <a href="/products/mixers/">Mixers</a>
    <a href="/products/trowels/">Trowels</a>
  </slab-navigation-menu-item>

  <a href="/contact/">Contact</a>
</slab-navigation-menu>
```

Each link and Navigation Menu Item gets an `<li>` of its own, and so does each link in an Item. An Item's content is in the flow, right below its button, and nothing positions it, so a dropdown is a design's: give `::part(content)` a `position: absolute` and the Item a `position: relative`, or leave the content in place for a menu on a phone. Opening one Item closes the others, and a click outside an Item, or focus leaving it, closes it too.

It isn't a [Menubar](menubar.md). A `[role=menu]` is for commands, like a desktop app's, and tells a screenreader user to expect only the arrow keys. Here the links are links, the buttons are buttons with `aria-expanded`, and Tab goes through all of them. Mark the current page's link with `aria-current="page"`.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                                                             |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab          | Moves through the links and buttons in order, including an open Item's links. Leaving an Item closes it. |
| Enter, Space | On an Item's button, opens or closes it.                                                                 |
| Down         | On an Item's button, opens it at its first link.                                                         |
| Up, Down     | In an open Item, moves to the previous or next link. Up from the first goes to the button.               |
| Home, End    | In an open Item, moves to its first or last link. In the row, to the first or last link or button.       |
| Left, Right  | In the row, moves to the previous or next link or button, wrapping.                                      |
| Escape       | Closes the open Item and returns focus to its button.                                                    |

## Elements

### `<slab-navigation-menu>`

Import `slab-elements/navigation-menu.js` to register it.

A Navigation Menu with no visual styles: a site's navigation, as a `<nav>` around a `<ul>` of links and Navigation Menu Items, each Item a button that shows and hides links of its own.

It's the APG's disclosure navigation, not a menu. A `[role=menu]` is for commands, like a desktop app's, and tells a screenreader user to expect the arrow keys and nothing else. Here the links are links, the buttons are buttons with `aria-expanded`, and Tab goes through all of them in order.

Each element slotted into it gets an `<li>` of its own, as in Breadcrumb. Opening one Item closes the others, and the arrow keys are a shortcut on top of Tab: Left and Right move between the links and Items' buttons in the row, wrapping at each end, and Home and End go to the first and last. In a right-to-left page, Left and Right swap.

Mark the link to the current page with `aria-current="page"`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type     | Default | Description           |
| ------------------ | -------- | ------- | --------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string` |         | Names the navigation. |

#### Properties

| Name                | Type        | Description                          |
| ------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `items` (read-only) | `Element[]` | Its Navigation Menu Items, in order. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type      | Description                                                         |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element` | The links and Navigation Menu Items, each in an \`<li>\` of its own |

#### CSS parts

| Name   | Description           |
| ------ | --------------------- |
| `item` | Each item's list item |
| `list` | The links and Items   |
| `nav`  | The navigation        |

### `<slab-navigation-menu-item>`

Import `slab-elements/navigation-menu.item.js` to register it.

A Navigation Menu Item with no visual styles: a button that shows and hides a list of links, the APG's disclosure navigation. It's not a menu. The button is a button with `aria-expanded`, the links are links in a list, and Tab goes through them in order.

Each element slotted into it gets an `<li>` of its own in a `<ul>`, as each in a Navigation Menu does. That's usually a link, but a design can slot in anything, such as a `<div>` with a heading and a short description.

The content is in the flow, below the button, so a design positions it, such as absolutely below the button for a dropdown, or left in place for a menu on a phone. It's `display: none` while closed.

Escape closes it and returns focus to the button. A click outside it, or focus leaving it by the keyboard, closes it too. In a Navigation Menu, opening one Item closes the others.

Down, on the button, opens it at the first link, and Up and Down move between the links. Up from the first goes back to the button.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                                    |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |         | The button's text and so its accessible name.  |
| `open`             | `boolean` | `false` | Whether it's open. Set it to open or close it. |

#### Properties

| Name                | Type        | Description                    |
| ------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------ |
| `items` (read-only) | `Element[]` | What's in its panel, in order. |

#### Methods

| Signature                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `click(): void`                       | Clicks it, as a native element's `click()` does.                                                                                                                                   |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                                                                                    |
| `hide(): void`                        | Closes it.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `show(): void`                        | Opens it.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `toggle(force?: boolean): boolean`    | Opens it when it's closed, and closes it when it's open, as a native popover's `togglePopover()` does. `true` only opens it and `false` only closes it. Returns whether it's open. |

#### Events

| Name     | Type          | Description                                                                                                          |
| -------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toggle` | `ToggleEvent` | When it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` with `oldState` and `newState` that doesn't bubble, as a popover's does. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type      | Description                               |
| --------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element` | The links, each in an \`<li>\` of its own |

#### CSS parts

| Name      | Description                                 |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `content` | The content shown when open                 |
| `item`    | Each link's list item                       |
| `list`    | The links                                   |
| `trigger` | The button that shows and hides the content |

#### CSS states

| Name           | Description      |
| -------------- | ---------------- |
| `:state(open)` | While it's open. |
